text: The card's done-when 'a fresh session in the bundle handles its replay item through the one session skill, the Meta-Agent absent' was watched once on 2026-11-12, on the person's word to this session ('open a fresh session in the echo 0002 bundle'). A fresh session, claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium, was opened in meta_agent/builds/echo/0002/bundle with a brief that named tasks/001-start.md and replay/rp-001.json and told it to write nothing, the bundle being a committed record. What it reported, and what this seat then read off its own runs in the same folder: gate 'gate: self-check ok'; replay 'replay: 2 item(s), 2 as expected, 0 not; OK'; validate_tasks 'gates: interface pass, scientific undecided; overall undecided'; the call of rp-001 through src/run_tool.py returned the message and its length as the item expects; git status in the bundle prints nothing and the bundle's hash equals the build card's. It loaded run-skill before the call, read library/index.md, found no library skill and so made the call through src/run_tool.py as CLAUDE.md says; it did not load the other two, nothing having entered a record and no subagent having been started. It said the folder was enough with nobody to ask. What it found wrong, all in template v3's text and so a next template version's, mine to make if the person wants it: (1) run-skill's description says it is for a device found, read or changed, but its procedure covers library skills only; for a tool with no library skill in front of it the session had to fall back on CLAUDE.md's line for src/run_tool.py. (2) the bundle's CLAUDE.md says 'This agent has no skills.' and then lists three session skills: the sentence means library skills. (3) tasks/001-start.md says all three commands print their OK or verdict lines, and src/validate_tasks.py exits with a failure status when the result is undecided, which a session alone could take for a failure. Not a fault of the bundle but of where it was run: opened inside this repository, the session was also given the root CLAUDE.md, meta_agent/CLAUDE.md and the Meta-Agent's session skills, and set them aside because its brief said to; MP2 is shown fully only in a folder outside the repository. For the card.
